notes.title: Patch Notes for Beta Fixes - 0.3.6
notes.content:

notes.title: Patch Notes for Beta Fixes - 0.3.5
notes.content:
🌟✨ New Features ✨🌟
- Balanced stages (Fire/Thunder)
- New Fire Boss: Fire Ball Boss
- New Thunder Boss: Lightning Rod Boss
- New Enemy: Touros (Visible only inside Water Tower or Wind Tower range)
- Wind Tower (Windmill) price reduced
- Earth Tower (Rock'nRoll) damage increased.
- Earth Tower Adaptaion Positive/Negative: Debuff removed
- Light Tower (Luminus) damage increased
- Water Tower (icewave) can now Frozen the pure air into clouds or rains!

- After defeating MiniBoss, the game take too long to start the next wave
- Typo fixes

notes.title: Patch Notes for Beta Fixes - 0.3.1
notes.content:
🌟✨ New Features ✨🌟
- Cooperative Mode and Combat!
- Polyoedia: Collect everything and learn some trivia. (Still incomplete)
- Balanced stages
- Store update values have been adjusted
- Serpentosaurus: The Boss of the Plant stage!
- Bosses in general have been updated
- Windmill now has lower upgrade values
- All towers now take exactly 3 seconds to build
- Damage per second is now dealt 10 times per second instead of depending on FPS
- New way to calculate Score
- Game menus are now easier to understand
- It is now possible to set the screen resolution through settings
- Rhom enemies are no longer immune to all towers, just very resistant

🐞 Bug Fixes 🐞
- All towers in general have been fixed; attack speed was inconsistent
- ELON enemies are now resistant to the type that received the most damage, except when it's their weakness
- Some redundant enemies have been removed
- The control settings screen only works once

notes.title: Beta Fixes Patch Notes - Version 0.2.1
notes.content:
🌟✨ New Features ✨🌟
- All Waves from stages 1 to 24 have been recreated to allow greater freedom of strategy, more use of towers and their upgrades
- UI now display accurate values for tower effects, such as Water Tower's slow, Wind Tower's Money Gain
- GameSpeed is now ranged between 1 and 6
- Wind Tower (Windmill) now give reduced gold while close to other Windmill
- Electrict Tower (Thunderbolt) balance
- More Enemies Types
- The heat now degrades the ice slowly

🐞 Bug Fixes 🐞
- Water Tower (Icewave) Power Left (Crystalyze) are not weakening the enemies properly
- Plant Bosses are too strong (Level 24)
- Boss destruction animation is interrupted by end game screen
- Gamepad fixes
- Fire Tower (Pyrocaster) Arc damage is not giving damage according to enemy size

notes.title: Beta Fixes Patch Notes - Version 0.1.10
notes.content:
🌟✨ New Features ✨🌟
- All Thunder stages released ⚡
- 1 Wind stage addded
- Tornados added to Wind stages
- SpeedUp enemy - The more damage, the faster it goes
- The enemies' path are now visible before start the game
- Light Tower (Luminus) balanced

🐞 Bug Fixes 🐞
- Thunder Tower (Thunderbolt) powered up as Thunder does not share energy
- Wind Tower (Windmill) xp are too slow
- Resistent Enemies (ELON) have no weakness, even when it should have
- Water Enemies are no weak against the Water Slow Effect
- Gamepad settings screen only works one time

notes.title: Beta Fixes Patch Notes - Version 0.1.5
notes.content:
Feature Changes:
- Leaderboards: Improved display.
- Tower Targeting: Towers are now smarter in selecting their targets.

notes.title: Beta Fixes Patch Notes - Version 0.1.4
notes.content:
Beta Fixes Patch Notes - Version 0.1.4

New Features:

Leaderboards Added: We're excited to introduce leaderboards to enhance your competitive gaming experience. Now you can compete with friends and players worldwide to claim the top spot in every stage.

Minor Fixes
- Element Materials: Improved values
- Auto Wave Icon: No more A/M letters
- Stage 6 Boss Timing Adjusted: Now the boss appears where he should

- Game Save fixes
